verdict.rationale: Managing downloaded models is well evidenced: the REST API covers managing models, and users praise `ollama pull` and `ollama rm`, with one calling model management Ollama's main edge over llama.cpp. Nothing shows saved prompts or a single unified place for this, and one user complains that Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults. Missing for 10: saved-prompt management, per-model configuration management, a unified single-place interface covering all three.
